findings.description: Lukewarm tea becomes cold tea prematurely.

contexts.WH: The cup of red tea that she had brought from the dining hall had gone cold......
contexts.MG: The cup of black tea that she had brought from the dining hall had gone cold...
contexts.UP: The cup of black tea that she had brought from the dining hall had gone stone cold......

MG.japanese:
だからといって、寛げているようには見えない。
彼女の表情は憂いと疲れで、ぼんやりとしていた。食堂から持ってきた紅茶のカップは、すっかりぬるくなってしまっている……。
MG.translation: That didn't mean she looked relaxed. Her expression was heavy with gloom and weariness. The cup of black tea that she had brought from the dining hall had gone cold...

UP.japanese:
だからといって、寛げているようには見えない。
彼女の表情は憂いと疲れで、ぼんやりとしていた。食堂から持ってきた紅茶のカップは、すっかりぬるくなってしまっている……。
UP.translation:
That didn't mean she looked relaxed.
Her expression was heavy with gloom and weariness. The cup of black tea that she had brought from the dining hall had gone stone cold......

findings.sourceReading: The tea has become lukewarm, ぬるく; only later, at the death scene, is it 冷め切った, completely cold.
findings.alternative: Cold can loosely mean no longer hot, but erases the explicit intermediate state and later cooling.

contexts.MG: Acknowledging each other's great dreams with nothing but words is a classic sort of pillow talk between lovers.
contexts.UP: Acknowledging each other's great dreams that might never be is a standard sort of pillow talk for lovers.

MG.japanese: 互いの高尚な夢を、口先だけで認め合うなんて、恋人同士の定番のピロートーク。でも、それに実際の行動が伴ったなら、………そこからは冷静に打算的であるべきだった。
MG.translation: Acknowledging each other's great dreams with nothing but words is a classic sort of pillow talk between lovers. However, when it comes to actually carrying them out, ...you need to be more serious and calculating.

findings.sourceReading: 口先だけで explicitly restricts the customary pillow-talk endorsement to words alone, followed by the need for calculation when action occurs.
findings.alternative: The next sentence preserves the action contrast, but omission weakens the explicit words-only qualification of the first.

findings.description: Demons' cruel honesty becomes an unassailable fact.

contexts.japanese: むしろこうして、恋に破れればそれは死だと、
contexts.japanesePC: むしろこうして、恋に破れればそれは死だと、残酷ではあっても、決して誤魔化さない点において誠実だとさえ言える...。

contexts.MG: It was at least accurate on this cruel but unassailable fact:
contexts.UP: In fact, although cruel, this could even be said to be an honest reflection of reality,

MG.translation: ...Those demons had not exaggerated when calling this trial a battle of love. It was at least accurate on this cruel but unassailable fact: that those who have their love shattered meet with death...

UP.japanese: ……あの悪魔どもが語る、恋を巡る試練の戦いは、決して誇張なんかされていない。むしろこうして、恋に破れればそれは死だと、残酷ではあっても、決して誤魔化さない点において誠実だとさえ言える…。
UP.translation: ......Those demons had not exaggerated when speaking of love as a battle and a trial. In fact, although cruel, this could even be said to be an honest reflection of reality, in the sense that it made no attempt to hide the fact that to lose in love is to die...

findings.sourceReading: The demons can even be called honest because, cruel though it is, they do not obscure that losing in love means death.

findings.description: MG changes the sword’s red trajectory into a curved blade.

contexts.japanese: 嘉音の手より伸びる赤い軌跡の剣が、たちまち霧散する。
contexts.japanesePS3: 嘉音の手より伸びる赤い軌跡の剣が、たちまち霧散する。
contexts.MG: The red curved blade extending from Kanon's hand vanished in an instant.
contexts.UP: The red‐trailing sword that extended from Kanon's hand dissipated in an instant.

MG.japanese: 嘉音の手より伸びる赤い軌跡の剣が、たちまち霧散する。消えたものを、再び顕現しようと努力するが、それをマリアたちに振るおうとすれば再び、霧散してしまう。さくたろうの力により、マリアたちを攻撃の対象とすることが出来ないのだ。
MG.translation: The red curved blade extending from Kanon's hand vanished in an instant. He tried hard to make it reappear, but when he attempted to use it on Maria and Sakutarou again, it vanished once more. Because of Sakutarou's power, he was unable to make either of them the target of his attacks.

UP.japanese: 嘉音の手より伸びる赤い軌跡の剣が、たちまち霧散する。消えたものを、再び顕現しようと努力するが、それをマリアたちに振るおうとすれば再び、霧散してしまう。さくたろうの力により、マリアたちを攻撃の対象とすることが出来ないのだ。
UP.translation: The red‐trailing sword that extended from Kanon's hand dissipated in an instant. He managed to make it reappear, but when he tried to use it on Maria and Sakutarou again, it vanished once more. Because of Sakutarou's power, he was unable to make either of them the target of his attacks.

findings.sourceReading: JP 赤い軌跡 describes a red trail; originalPC90661/90662 describes red locus, and UP red-trailing. MG red curved blade describes intrinsic geometry.
findings.alternative: A swing can trace a curve, but the source does not say that the blade itself is curved.
